name: COASTAL
recent: COASTAL 近期有多位主要管理人员在闭门期前表示有意买卖公司证券，同时公司因 ESOS 行使而持续发行新股。新闻方面，市场关注其墨西哥项目对盈利的贡献。
notable: 多位主要管理人员（包括 CFO）在闭门期前通知有意买卖公司证券。
公司因 ESOS 行使而发行 146,500 股新股，上市日为 2026 年 11 月 20 日。
新闻标题提及墨西哥项目将带动盈利增长。
risks: 多位管理人员在闭门期前表示有意交易，可能引发市场对内部人交易的关注。
ESOS 行使导致股本逐步增加，存在轻微摊薄效应。

recent_en: COASTAL recently saw several principal officers indicate their intention to deal in the company's securities ahead of the closed period, while the company continues to issue new shares from ESOS exercises. In the news, market attention is on the profit contribution from its Mexico projects.
notable_en: Several principal officers, including the CFO, notified their intention to deal in the company's securities ahead of the closed period.
The company issued 146,500 new shares from ESOS exercise, with listing date on 20 Nov 2026.
News headlines mention Mexico projects will drive profit growth.
risks_en: Multiple officers indicated intention to trade ahead of the closed period, which may raise market attention on insider dealings.
ESOS exercises gradually increase share capital, with a slight dilutive effect.
